#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build the kvhttp release binary at ./app from the AArch64 sources in src/.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"

CC=${CC:-clang}
"$CC" -arch arm64 -mcpu=apple-m1 -O2 -I src \
    -Wl,-dead_strip \
    -o app src/main.s src/conn.s src/http.s src/store.s
strip -x app 2>/dev/null || true

// conn.s — per-connection thread: socket setup, request handling, and a
// graceful close (half-close + drain) so unread request bytes never turn the
// close into a RST that could destroy the response in flight.

        .include "macros.inc"

        .text

// void set_opt_int(int fd w0, int level w1, int name w2, int value w3)
        .p2align 2
set_opt_int:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov     x29, sp
        sub     sp, sp, #16
        str     w3, [sp]
        mov     x3, sp
        mov     w4, #4
        bl      _setsockopt
        add     sp, sp, #16
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret

// void set_opt_timeout(int fd w0, int name w1)
        .p2align 2
set_opt_timeout:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
        mov     x29, sp
        sub     sp, sp, #16
        mov     x8, #IO_TIMEOUT_SEC
        stp     x8, xzr, [sp]               // struct timeval { tv_sec, tv_usec }
        mov     w2, w1
        mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
        mov     x3, sp
        mov     w4, #16
        bl      _setsockopt
        add     sp, sp, #16
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #16
        ret

// void *conn_main(void *arg) — arg carries the client fd.
        .globl  _conn_main
        .p2align 2
_conn_main:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        sub     sp, sp, #4096               // drain buffer
        mov     w19, w0

        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
        mov     w2, #SO_NOSIGPIPE
        mov     w3, #1
        bl      set_opt_int
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #IPPROTO_TCP
        mov     w2, #TCP_NODELAY
        mov     w3, #1
        bl      set_opt_int
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #SO_RCVTIMEO
        bl      set_opt_timeout
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #SO_SNDTIMEO
        bl      set_opt_timeout

        mov     w0, w19
        bl      _http_handle

        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #SHUT_WR
        bl      _shutdown
        mov     x20, #DRAIN_LIMIT
1:      mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, sp
        mov     x2, #4096
        bl      _read
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.le    2f
        subs    x20, x20, x0
        b.gt    1b
2:      mov     w0, w19
        bl      _close

        mov     x0, #0
        add     sp, sp, #4096
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #32
        ret

// http.s — HTTP/1.1 request parsing, routing and response writing.

        .include "macros.inc"

        .equ    M_OTHER,        0
        .equ    M_GET,          1
        .equ    M_PUT,          2
        .equ    M_DELETE,       3

        .equ    RESP_BUF,       1024        // header + small inline body
        .equ    INLINE_BODY,    512         // bodies up to this size share the header write

        .section __TEXT,__const
// Status line records: 32 bytes each, terminated by a zero code whose text
// is used as the fallback.
.macro STATUS code, text
        .p2align 5
        .word   \code
        .asciz  "\text"
.endm
Lstatus_table:
        STATUS  200, "200 OK"
        STATUS  201, "201 Created"
        STATUS  204, "204 No Content"
        STATUS  400, "400 Bad Request"
        STATUS  404, "404 Not Found"
        STATUS  405, "405 Method Not Allowed"
        STATUS  413, "413 Content Too Large"
        STATUS  0,   "500 Internal Server Error"

Lcl_name:       .ascii "content-length:"        // compared case-insensitively

        .section __TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals
Ls_http:        .asciz "HTTP/1.1 "
Ls_clen:        .asciz "\r\nContent-Length: "
Ls_ctype:       .asciz "Content-Type: "
Ls_crlf:        .asciz "\r\n"
Ls_close:       .asciz "Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
Ls_json:        .asciz "application/json"
Ls_ok:          .asciz "ok"
Ls_get:         .asciz "GET"
Ls_put:         .asciz "PUT"
Ls_delete:      .asciz "DELETE"
Ls_health:      .asciz "/health"
Ls_kv:          .asciz "/kv"

        .text

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Small leaf helpers
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

// bool mem_eq(a x0, alen x1, b x2, blen x3)
        .p2align 2
mem_eq:
        cmp     x1, x3
        b.ne    2f
1:      cbz     x1, 3f
        ldrb    w4, [x0], #1
        ldrb    w5, [x2], #1
        sub     x1, x1, #1
        cmp     w4, w5
        b.eq    1b
2:      mov     w0, #0
        ret
3:      mov     w0, #1
        ret

// char *str_append(dst x0, const char *src x1) — returns the new end of dst.
        .p2align 2
str_append:
1:      ldrb    w2, [x1], #1
        cbz     w2, 2f
        strb    w2, [x0], #1
        b       1b
2:      ret

// char *u64_to_dec(dst x0, value x1) — returns the new end of dst.
        .p2align 2
u64_to_dec:
        mov     x4, #10
        mov     x2, x1
1:      udiv    x2, x2, x4                  // count digits
        add     x0, x0, #1
        cbnz    x2, 1b
        mov     x5, x0
2:      udiv    x2, x1, x4
        msub    x6, x2, x4, x1
        add     w6, w6, #'0'
        strb    w6, [x5, #-1]!
        mov     x1, x2
        cbnz    x1, 2b
        ret

// const char *status_text(int code w0)
        .p2align 2
status_text:
        LOADADDR x1, Lstatus_table
1:      ldr     w2, [x1]
        cbz     w2, 2f
        cmp     w2, w0
        b.eq    2f
        add     x1, x1, #32
        b       1b
2:      add     x0, x1, #4
        ret

// int write_all(int fd w0, const void *buf x1, size_t len x2) — 0 or -1.
        .p2align 2
write_all:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        str     x21, [sp, #32]
        mov     w19, w0
        mov     x20, x1
        mov     x21, x2
1:      cbz     x21, 3f
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, x20
        mov     x2, x21
        bl      _write
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.gt    2f
        b.eq    4f
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    1b
        b       4f
2:      add     x20, x20, x0
        sub     x21, x21, x0
        b       1b
3:      mov     w0, #0
        b       5f
4:      mov     w0, #-1
5:      ldr     x21, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret

// void send_response(int fd w0, int status w1, const void *body x2,
//                    size_t len x3, const char *content_type x4 /* or NULL */)
        .p2align 2
send_response:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        sub     sp, sp, #RESP_BUF
        mov     w19, w0
        mov     w20, w1
        mov     x21, x2
        mov     x22, x3
        mov     x23, x4

        mov     x0, sp
        LOADADDR x1, Ls_http
        bl      str_append
        mov     x24, x0
        mov     w0, w20
        bl      status_text
        mov     x1, x0
        mov     x0, x24
        bl      str_append
        LOADADDR x1, Ls_clen
        bl      str_append
        mov     x1, x22
        bl      u64_to_dec
        LOADADDR x1, Ls_crlf
        bl      str_append
        cbz     x23, 1f
        LOADADDR x1, Ls_ctype
        bl      str_append
        mov     x1, x23
        bl      str_append
        LOADADDR x1, Ls_crlf
        bl      str_append
1:      LOADADDR x1, Ls_close
        bl      str_append
        mov     x24, x0                     // end of header

        cbz     x22, 2f
        cmp     x22, #INLINE_BODY
        b.hi    2f
        mov     x1, x21
        mov     x2, x22
        bl      _memcpy
        add     x24, x24, x22
        mov     x22, #0
2:      mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, sp
        sub     x2, x24, x1
        bl      write_all
        cbnz    w0, 3f
        cbz     x22, 3f
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     x1, x21
        mov     x2, x22
        bl      write_all
3:      add     sp, sp, #RESP_BUF
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #64
        ret

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
// void http_handle(int fd w0) — read one request, dispatch, respond.
//
//   x19 fd            x20 header buffer      x21 bytes buffered / body bytes
//   x22 header end    x23 method / key ptr   x24 method / key length
//   x25 path ptr      x26 path length        x27 Content-Length
//   x28 request body blob (owned until handed to the store)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
        .globl  _http_handle
        .p2align 2
_http_handle:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-96]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        stp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        stp     x27, x28, [sp, #80]
        sub     sp, sp, #HDR_CAP
        mov     w19, w0
        mov     x20, sp
        mov     x21, #0
        mov     x28, #0

        // --- read until the blank line that ends the header block ---
Lread_more:
        mov     x2, #HDR_CAP
        subs    x2, x2, x21
        b.eq    L400                        // header block too large
        mov     w0, w19
        add     x1, x20, x21
        bl      _read
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.gt    1f
        b.eq    Ldone
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    Lread_more
        b       Ldone
1:      subs    x9, x21, #3                 // rescan the last 3 old bytes
        csel    x9, xzr, x9, lo
        add     x21, x21, x0
        movz    w12, #0x0a0d
        movk    w12, #0x0a0d, lsl #16       // "\r\n\r\n"
2:      add     x10, x9, #4
        cmp     x10, x21
        b.hi    Lread_more
        ldr     w11, [x20, x9]
        cmp     w11, w12
        b.eq    3f
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       2b
3:      add     x22, x9, #4

        // --- request line: METHOD SP PATH SP VERSION CRLF ---
        mov     x9, #0
1:      ldrb    w10, [x20, x9]
        cmp     w10, #' '
        b.eq    2f
        cmp     w10, #'\r'
        b.eq    L400
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       1b
2:      cbz     x9, L400
        mov     x23, x20
        mov     x24, x9
        add     x9, x9, #1
        add     x25, x20, x9
        mov     x10, x9
3:      ldrb    w11, [x20, x10]
        cmp     w11, #' '
        b.eq    4f
        cmp     w11, #'\r'
        b.eq    L400
        add     x10, x10, #1
        b       3b
4:      subs    x26, x10, x9
        b.eq    L400
5:      ldrb    w11, [x20, x10]             // skip the version to end of line
        cmp     w11, #'\r'
        b.eq    6f
        add     x10, x10, #1
        b       5b
6:      add     x10, x10, #2

        // --- header fields: only Content-Length matters ---
        mov     x27, #0
        LOADADDR x14, Lcl_name
Lhdr_loop:
        sub     x11, x22, #2
        cmp     x10, x11
        b.hs    Lhdr_done
        mov     x12, x10
1:      ldrb    w13, [x20, x12]
        cmp     w13, #'\r'
        b.eq    2f
        add     x12, x12, #1
        b       1b
2:      sub     x13, x12, x10               // line is [x10, x12)
        cmp     x13, #15
        b.lo    Lhdr_next
        mov     x15, #0
3:      add     x16, x10, x15
        ldrb    w16, [x20, x16]
        orr     w16, w16, #0x20
        ldrb    w17, [x14, x15]
        cmp     w16, w17
        b.ne    Lhdr_next
        add     x15, x15, #1
        cmp     x15, #15
        b.lo    3b

        add     x15, x10, #15               // value: OWS 1*DIGIT OWS
        bl      Lskip_ows
        mov     x27, #0
        mov     x16, #0
        mov     x17, #10
        movz    x9, #1, lsl #32             // saturation bound (well above MAX_VALUE)
4:      cmp     x15, x12
        b.hs    5f
        ldrb    w13, [x20, x15]
        sub     w13, w13, #'0'
        cmp     w13, #9
        b.hi    5f
        madd    x27, x27, x17, x13
        cmp     x27, x9
        csel    x27, x9, x27, hi
        add     x16, x16, #1
        add     x15, x15, #1
        b       4b
5:      cbz     x16, L400
        bl      Lskip_ows
        cmp     x15, x12
        b.ne    L400
Lhdr_next:
        add     x10, x12, #2
        b       Lhdr_loop

        // Local leaf: advance x15 over spaces/tabs while x15 < x12.
Lskip_ows:
        cmp     x15, x12
        b.hs    2f
        ldrb    w13, [x20, x15]
        cmp     w13, #' '
        b.eq    1f
        cmp     w13, #'\t'
        b.ne    2f
1:      add     x15, x15, #1
        b       Lskip_ows
2:      ret

        // --- body: read exactly Content-Length bytes into a value blob ---
Lhdr_done:
        mov     x8, #MAX_VALUE
        cmp     x27, x8
        b.hi    L413
        add     x0, x27, #BLOB_DATA
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, L500
        mov     x28, x0
        mov     x8, #1
        stp     x8, x27, [x28, #BLOB_REFS]
        sub     x2, x21, x22                // body bytes already buffered
        cmp     x2, x27
        csel    x2, x27, x2, hi
        mov     x21, x2
        add     x0, x28, #BLOB_DATA
        add     x1, x20, x22
        bl      _memcpy
Lbody_loop:
        cmp     x21, x27
        b.hs    Lroute
        mov     w0, w19
        add     x1, x28, #BLOB_DATA
        add     x1, x1, x21
        sub     x2, x27, x21
        bl      _read
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.gt    1f
        b.eq    Ldone
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    Lbody_loop
        b       Ldone
1:      add     x21, x21, x0
        b       Lbody_loop

        // --- routing ---
Lroute:
        mov     x22, #M_GET
        mov     x0, x23
        mov     x1, x24
        LOADADDR x2, Ls_get
        mov     x3, #3
        bl      mem_eq
        cbnz    w0, 1f
        mov     x22, #M_PUT
        mov     x0, x23
        mov     x1, x24
        LOADADDR x2, Ls_put
        mov     x3, #3
        bl      mem_eq
        cbnz    w0, 1f
        mov     x22, #M_DELETE
        mov     x0, x23
        mov     x1, x24
        LOADADDR x2, Ls_delete
        mov     x3, #6
        bl      mem_eq
        cbnz    w0, 1f
        mov     x22, #M_OTHER
1:
        mov     x0, x25
        mov     x1, x26
        LOADADDR x2, Ls_health
        mov     x3, #7
        bl      mem_eq
        cbnz    w0, Lr_health
        mov     x0, x25
        mov     x1, x26
        LOADADDR x2, Ls_kv
        mov     x3, #3
        bl      mem_eq
        cbnz    w0, Lr_list
        cmp     x26, #4
        b.lo    L404
        ldr     w8, [x25]
        movz    w9, #0x6b2f
        movk    w9, #0x2f76, lsl #16        // "/kv/"
        cmp     w8, w9
        b.ne    L404

        // /kv/<key>: validate [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}
        add     x23, x25, #4
        sub     x24, x26, #4
        cbz     x24, L400
        cmp     x24, #KEY_MAX
        b.hi    L400
        mov     x9, #0
2:      ldrb    w10, [x23, x9]
        sub     w11, w10, #'0'
        cmp     w11, #10
        b.lo    3f
        orr     w11, w10, #0x20
        sub     w11, w11, #'a'
        cmp     w11, #26
        b.lo    3f
        cmp     w10, #'_'
        b.eq    3f
        cmp     w10, #'-'
        b.ne    L400
3:      add     x9, x9, #1
        cmp     x9, x24
        b.lo    2b

        cmp     x22, #M_GET
        b.eq    Lr_get
        cmp     x22, #M_PUT
        b.eq    Lr_put
        cmp     x22, #M_DELETE
        b.eq    Lr_delete
        b       L405

Lr_health:
        cmp     x22, #M_GET
        b.ne    L405
        mov     w1, #200
        LOADADDR x2, Ls_ok
        mov     x3, #2
        mov     x4, #0
        b       Lrespond

Lr_list:
        cmp     x22, #M_GET
        b.ne    L405
        bl      _store_list
        cbz     x0, L500
        mov     x21, x0
        mov     x2, x0
        mov     x3, x1
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #200
        LOADADDR x4, Ls_json
        bl      send_response
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _free
        b       Ldone

Lr_get:
        mov     x0, x23
        mov     x1, x24
        bl      _store_get
        cbz     x0, L404
        mov     x21, x0
        mov     w0, w19
        mov     w1, #200
        add     x2, x21, #BLOB_DATA
        ldr     x3, [x21, #BLOB_LEN]
        mov     x4, #0
        bl      send_response
        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _blob_release
        b       Ldone

Lr_put:
        mov     x0, x23
        mov     x1, x24
        mov     x2, x28
        bl      _store_put
        tbnz    x0, #63, L500
        mov     x28, #0                     // the store owns the blob now
        mov     w1, #200
        mov     w8, #201
        cmp     x0, #0
        csel    w1, w8, w1, ne
        b       Lrespond_empty

Lr_delete:
        mov     x0, x23
        mov     x1, x24
        bl      _store_delete
        cbz     x0, L404
        mov     w1, #204
        b       Lrespond_empty

L400:   mov     w1, #400
        b       Lrespond_empty
L404:   mov     w1, #404
        b       Lrespond_empty
L405:   mov     w1, #405
        b       Lrespond_empty
L413:   mov     w1, #413
        b       Lrespond_empty
L500:   mov     w1, #500
Lrespond_empty:
        mov     x2, #0
        mov     x3, #0
        mov     x4, #0
Lrespond:
        mov     w0, w19
        bl      send_response

Ldone:
        mov     x0, x28
        bl      _blob_release
        add     sp, sp, #HDR_CAP
        ldp     x27, x28, [sp, #80]
        ldp     x25, x26, [sp, #64]
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #96
        ret

// main.s — process entry, listening socket and the accept loop.
// One detached thread per connection; each connection serves one request.

        .include "macros.inc"

        .section __TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals
Lmsg_usage:     .asciz "usage: app <port>\n"
Lmsg_init:      .asciz "store init"
Lmsg_socket:    .asciz "socket"
Lmsg_bind:      .asciz "bind"
Lmsg_listen:    .asciz "listen"

        .text

// long parse_port(const char *s x0) — 1..65535, or -1 when invalid.
        .p2align 2
parse_port:
        mov     x1, #0                      // value
        mov     x2, #0                      // digits
        mov     x4, #10
1:      ldrb    w3, [x0], #1
        cbz     w3, 2f
        sub     w3, w3, #'0'
        cmp     w3, #9
        b.hi    3f
        madd    x1, x1, x4, x3
        add     x2, x2, #1
        cmp     x2, #5
        b.hi    3f
        b       1b
2:      cbz     x2, 3f
        cbz     x1, 3f
        mov     x5, #65535
        cmp     x1, x5
        b.hi    3f
        mov     x0, x1
        ret
3:      mov     x0, #-1
        ret

        .globl  _main
        .p2align 2
_main:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        // [sp,#40] int scratch, [sp,#48..63] struct sockaddr_in
        cmp     w0, #2
        b.ne    Lusage
        ldr     x0, [x1, #8]
        bl      parse_port
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.le    Lusage
        mov     x19, x0

        mov     w0, #SIGPIPE
        mov     x1, #SIG_IGN
        bl      _signal

        bl      _store_init
        LOADADDR x1, Lmsg_init
        cbnz    w0, Lfatal

        mov     w0, #AF_INET
        mov     w1, #SOCK_STREAM
        mov     w2, #0
        bl      _socket
        LOADADDR x1, Lmsg_socket
        tbnz    w0, #31, Lfatal
        mov     w20, w0

        mov     w8, #1
        str     w8, [sp, #40]
        mov     w0, w20
        mov     w1, #SOL_SOCKET
        mov     w2, #SO_REUSEADDR
        add     x3, sp, #40
        mov     w4, #4
        bl      _setsockopt

        // sockaddr_in { len=16, family=AF_INET, port (BE), 127.0.0.1, zero[8] }
        movz    x8, #0x0210
        movk    x8, #0x007f, lsl #32
        movk    x8, #0x0100, lsl #48
        rev16   w9, w19
        orr     x8, x8, x9, lsl #16
        stp     x8, xzr, [sp, #48]
        mov     w0, w20
        add     x1, sp, #48
        mov     w2, #16
        bl      _bind
        LOADADDR x1, Lmsg_bind
        tbnz    w0, #31, Lfatal

        mov     w0, w20
        mov     w1, #LISTEN_BACKLOG
        bl      _listen
        LOADADDR x1, Lmsg_listen
        tbnz    w0, #31, Lfatal

Laccept:
        mov     w0, w20
        mov     x1, #0
        mov     x2, #0
        bl      _accept
        tbz     w0, #31, Lspawn
        bl      ___error
        ldr     w8, [x0]
        cmp     w8, #EINTR
        b.eq    Laccept
        cmp     w8, #ECONNABORTED
        b.eq    Laccept
        mov     w0, #10000                  // fd/memory exhaustion: back off 10 ms
        bl      _usleep
        b       Laccept
Lspawn:
        bl      conn_spawn
        b       Laccept

Lusage:
        mov     w0, #2
        LOADADDR x1, Lmsg_usage
        mov     x2, #18
        bl      _write
        mov     w0, #2
        bl      _exit

Lfatal:                                     // x1 = message for perror
        mov     x0, x1
        bl      _perror
        mov     w0, #1
        bl      _exit

// void conn_spawn(int fd w0) — hand the connection to a detached thread.
        .p2align 2
conn_spawn:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!
        mov     x29, sp
        str     x19, [sp, #16]
        mov     w19, w0
        add     x0, sp, #24                 // pthread_t
        mov     x1, #0
        LOADADDR x2, _conn_main
        mov     w3, w19                     // fd passed as the thread argument
        bl      _pthread_create
        cbnz    w0, 1f
        ldr     x0, [sp, #24]
        bl      _pthread_detach
        b       2f
1:      mov     w0, w19
        bl      _close
2:      ldr     x19, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #32
        ret

// store.s — thread-safe in-memory key/value store.
//
// Keys live in a sorted array of entry pointers (binary search for lookup,
// memmove for insert/delete), which makes the sorted key listing trivial.
// Values are reference-counted blobs so a reader can stream a value to its
// client without holding the lock while a writer replaces or deletes it.

        .include "macros.inc"

        .zerofill __DATA,__bss,_g_lock,64,4         // pthread_mutex_t
        .zerofill __DATA,__bss,_g_entries,8,3       // entry **
        .zerofill __DATA,__bss,_g_count,8,3
        .zerofill __DATA,__bss,_g_cap,8,3

        .text

// int store_init(void) — returns 0 on success.
        .globl  _store_init
        .p2align 2
_store_init:
        LOADADDR x0, _g_lock
        mov     x1, #0
        b       _pthread_mutex_init

        .p2align 2
store_lock:
        LOADADDR x0, _g_lock
        b       _pthread_mutex_lock

        .p2align 2
store_unlock:
        LOADADDR x0, _g_lock
        b       _pthread_mutex_unlock

// long key_cmp(a x0, alen x1, b x2, blen x3) — leaf, bytewise ordering.
        .p2align 2
key_cmp:
        cmp     x1, x3
        csel    x4, x1, x3, lo              // min length
        mov     x5, #0
1:      cmp     x5, x4
        b.hs    2f
        ldrb    w6, [x0, x5]
        ldrb    w7, [x2, x5]
        add     x5, x5, #1
        subs    w6, w6, w7
        b.eq    1b
        sxtw    x0, w6
        ret
2:      sub     x0, x1, x3
        ret

// (index x0, found x1) store_find(key x0, klen x1) — caller holds the lock.
// When not found, index is the insertion point.
        .p2align 2
store_find:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        mov     x19, x0                     // key
        mov     x20, x1                     // klen
        mov     x21, #0                     // lo
        adrp    x8, _g_count@PAGE
        ldr     x22, [x8, _g_count@PAGEOFF] // hi
        adrp    x8, _g_entries@PAGE
        ldr     x23, [x8, _g_entries@PAGEOFF]
1:      cmp     x21, x22
        b.hs    3f
        add     x24, x21, x22
        lsr     x24, x24, #1                // mid
        ldr     x9, [x23, x24, lsl #3]
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        add     x2, x9, #ENT_KEY
        ldr     x3, [x9, #ENT_KLEN]
        bl      key_cmp
        cmp     x0, #0
        b.eq    2f
        b.lt    4f
        add     x21, x24, #1                // key > mid
        b       1b
4:      mov     x22, x24                    // key < mid
        b       1b
2:      mov     x0, x24
        mov     x1, #1
        b       5f
3:      mov     x0, x21
        mov     x1, #0
5:      ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #64
        ret

// void blob_release(blob x0) — drop one reference, free on last.
        .globl  _blob_release
        .p2align 2
_blob_release:
        cbz     x0, 1f
        mov     x1, #-1
        ldaddal x1, x2, [x0]
        cmp     x2, #1
        b.ne    1f
        b       _free
1:      ret

// long store_put(key x0, klen x1, blob x2)
//   -> 1 created, 0 replaced, -1 out of memory (blob ownership not taken).
// On success the store owns the caller's reference to blob.
        .globl  _store_put
        .p2align 2
_store_put:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-64]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        stp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1
        mov     x21, x2

        // Build the entry outside the lock; discarded if the key exists.
        mov     x0, #ENT_SIZE
        bl      _malloc
        cbz     x0, Lput_oom
        mov     x22, x0
        stp     x20, x21, [x22, #ENT_KLEN]
        add     x0, x22, #ENT_KEY
        mov     x1, x19
        mov     x2, x20
        bl      _memcpy

        bl      store_lock
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      store_find
        mov     x23, x0                     // index
        cbnz    x1, Lput_replace

        adrp    x8, _g_count@PAGE
        ldr     x9, [x8, _g_count@PAGEOFF]
        adrp    x10, _g_cap@PAGE
        ldr     x11, [x10, _g_cap@PAGEOFF]
        cmp     x9, x11
        b.lo    Lput_room
        lsl     x24, x11, #1
        mov     x12, #64
        cmp     x11, #0
        csel    x24, x12, x24, eq           // new capacity
        adrp    x8, _g_entries@PAGE
        ldr     x0, [x8, _g_entries@PAGEOFF]
        lsl     x1, x24, #3
        bl      _realloc
        cbz     x0, Lput_oom_locked
        adrp    x8, _g_entries@PAGE
        str     x0, [x8, _g_entries@PAGEOFF]
        adrp    x8, _g_cap@PAGE
        str     x24, [x8, _g_cap@PAGEOFF]

Lput_room:
        adrp    x8, _g_entries@PAGE
        ldr     x24, [x8, _g_entries@PAGEOFF]
        adrp    x8, _g_count@PAGE
        ldr     x9, [x8, _g_count@PAGEOFF]
        add     x10, x9, #1
        str     x10, [x8, _g_count@PAGEOFF]
        add     x1, x24, x23, lsl #3        // &e[idx]
        add     x0, x1, #8                  // &e[idx+1]
        sub     x2, x9, x23
        lsl     x2, x2, #3
        bl      _memmove
        str     x22, [x24, x23, lsl #3]
        bl      store_unlock
        mov     x0, #1
        b       Lput_ret

Lput_replace:
        adrp    x8, _g_entries@PAGE
        ldr     x8, [x8, _g_entries@PAGEOFF]
        ldr     x9, [x8, x23, lsl #3]
        ldr     x24, [x9, #ENT_BLOB]        // old value
        str     x21, [x9, #ENT_BLOB]
        bl      store_unlock
        mov     x0, x24
        bl      _blob_release
        mov     x0, x22
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, #0
        b       Lput_ret

Lput_oom_locked:
        bl      store_unlock
        mov     x0, x22
        bl      _free
Lput_oom:
        mov     x0, #-1
Lput_ret:
        ldp     x23, x24, [sp, #48]
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #64
        ret

// blob *store_get(key x0, klen x1) — returns a new reference, or NULL.
        .globl  _store_get
        .p2align 2
_store_get:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1
        bl      store_lock
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      store_find
        mov     x19, #0
        cbz     x1, 1f
        adrp    x8, _g_entries@PAGE
        ldr     x8, [x8, _g_entries@PAGEOFF]
        ldr     x9, [x8, x0, lsl #3]
        ldr     x19, [x9, #ENT_BLOB]
        mov     x10, #1
        stadd   x10, [x19]                  // ordered by the mutex release below
1:      bl      store_unlock
        mov     x0, x19
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #32
        ret

// long store_delete(key x0, klen x1) — 1 if deleted, 0 if absent.
        .globl  _store_delete
        .p2align 2
_store_delete:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-32]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        mov     x19, x0
        mov     x20, x1
        bl      store_lock
        mov     x0, x19
        mov     x1, x20
        bl      store_find
        cbz     x1, 1f
        adrp    x8, _g_entries@PAGE
        ldr     x10, [x8, _g_entries@PAGEOFF]
        ldr     x19, [x10, x0, lsl #3]      // victim entry
        adrp    x8, _g_count@PAGE
        ldr     x9, [x8, _g_count@PAGEOFF]
        sub     x9, x9, #1
        str     x9, [x8, _g_count@PAGEOFF]
        sub     x2, x9, x0
        lsl     x2, x2, #3
        add     x0, x10, x0, lsl #3         // &e[idx]
        add     x1, x0, #8                  // &e[idx+1]
        bl      _memmove
        bl      store_unlock
        ldr     x0, [x19, #ENT_BLOB]
        bl      _blob_release
        mov     x0, x19
        bl      _free
        mov     x0, #1
        b       2f
1:      bl      store_unlock
        mov     x0, #0
2:      ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #32
        ret

// (buf x0, len x1) store_list(void) — malloc'd JSON array of all keys in
// ascending order; buf is NULL on allocation failure. Keys never need JSON
// escaping because of the restricted key alphabet.
        .globl  _store_list
        .p2align 2
_store_list:
        stp     x29, x30, [sp, #-48]!
        mov     x29, sp
        stp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        stp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        bl      store_lock
        adrp    x8, _g_count@PAGE
        ldr     x19, [x8, _g_count@PAGEOFF]
        adrp    x8, _g_entries@PAGE
        ldr     x20, [x8, _g_entries@PAGEOFF]

        // size = "[" + "]" + sum(klen + 2 quotes) + (count - 1) commas
        mov     x21, #2
        mov     x9, #0
1:      cmp     x9, x19
        b.hs    2f
        ldr     x10, [x20, x9, lsl #3]
        ldr     x11, [x10, #ENT_KLEN]
        add     x21, x21, x11
        add     x21, x21, #3
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       1b
2:      cmp     x19, #0
        cset    x9, ne
        sub     x21, x21, x9

        mov     x0, x21
        bl      _malloc
        mov     x22, x0
        cbz     x0, 7f

        mov     x0, x22                     // write cursor
        mov     w12, #'['
        strb    w12, [x0], #1
        mov     w13, #'"'
        mov     w14, #','
        mov     x9, #0
3:      cmp     x9, x19
        b.hs    6f
        cbz     x9, 4f
        strb    w14, [x0], #1
4:      strb    w13, [x0], #1
        ldr     x10, [x20, x9, lsl #3]
        ldr     x11, [x10, #ENT_KLEN]
        add     x10, x10, #ENT_KEY
5:      ldrb    w15, [x10], #1
        strb    w15, [x0], #1
        subs    x11, x11, #1
        b.ne    5b
        strb    w13, [x0], #1
        add     x9, x9, #1
        b       3b
6:      mov     w12, #']'
        strb    w12, [x0]
7:      bl      store_unlock
        mov     x0, x22
        mov     x1, x21
        ldp     x21, x22, [sp, #32]
        ldp     x19, x20, [sp, #16]
        ldp     x29, x30, [sp], #48
        ret
